Rule 3 dedupes per LINE and the regex is one line, so this entry stays at 1 whichever classes are complete; the cross-language contract is enforced by the NFD + Devanagari vectors in conformance/reference-tokens.vectors.json, which both the TS and Rust parity suites drive.
